about: Every scan the tracing pipeline reads: where it comes from, and the rights checked on the holder's own page before downloading. Files land in tools/trace/raw/<id>/ (gitignored); re-download with: tools/trace/.venv/bin/python -I tools/trace/trace.py fetch <id>. verdict: clean = public-domain work and an open copy (no non-commercial or share-alike terms on the scan).

palmer-1915.title: The Palmer Method of Business Writing
palmer-1915.author: Austin Norman Palmer (1859–1927)
palmer-1915.place: New York, Chicago, Portland and Cedar Rapids: The A. N. Palmer Company
palmer-1915.holder: Smithsonian Libraries; scanned for the Biodiversity Heritage Library, hosted by the Internet Archive

rights.statement: Public domain. The Library considers that this work is no longer under copyright protection.
rights.notes: US publication of 1915 (before 1931); the author died in 1927, so the work is also out of copyright under life + 70 everywhere. Don't use the name 'Palmer Method' as a product name (trademark); describe the hand as American business writing, 1915.

suetterlin-1917.title: Neuer Leitfaden für den Schreibunterricht
suetterlin-1917.author: Ludwig Sütterlin (1865–1917)
suetterlin-1917.holder: Wikimedia Commons scan of page 85, figure 33 ('Lateinisches Alphabet mit Schnurzug')

rights.statement: Public domain (Commons: LicenseShortName 'Public domain', Copyrighted: False; author died 1917).
rights.notes: Author died 1917: public domain worldwide (life + 70 and life + 100). A faithful scan of a 2-D page adds no new rights (EU DSM Directive Art. 14; Bridgeman v. Corel in the US).
